caption: The drawing features a single shoe depicted in a naturalistic style, set against a plain, off-white background. The shoe is a slip-on type with a rounded toe and open sides, resembling a sandal or slipper. It is primarily shaded in tones of brown, with darker brown outlines and lighter brown highlights used to create a sense of dimension and texture, suggesting a leather material. There are two thin, light-colored straps, one visible on each side of the opening, and small circular details near the bottom edge of the shoe hint at stitching or decorative buttons. The composition places the shoe slightly off-center, with the toe pointing to the lower right and the heel to the upper left, casting no visible shadow. The entire drawing is rendered with fine, precise lines and soft shading.
title: Shoe
